audience: Decision makers who need a concise, evidence-based project overview
readerDecision: Decide whether the documented proposal should move into the next review stage

artDirection.concept: A restrained decision document whose visual hierarchy makes evidence easy to scan

layout.grid: Editorial single-column grid with one optional evidence rail
layout.rhythm: Generous section openings followed by compact evidence groups
layout.density: Moderate density with visible separation between decisions

artDirection.signatureElement: One document-specific evidence composition derived from the subject matter

evidenceSources: Approved source material supplied with the document request
cta: Confirm the next review step with the named sender
subjectMaterials: Approved project copy and licensed visual assets

sender.name: Document owner
sender.contact: Verified contact from the source material
